messages:
amelia: quick note — while reviewing the dashboards folder I found a cluster of examples that break after the tracehook v2 rename + a few dead links in the cost/latency widgets. tagging to coordinate a small sweep.

samir: ouch. do you have a short list? can help tomorrow morning. :coffee:

amelia: yes — collected paths in a gist: https://internal.gists/re/5777-obsv-orphans (summary below). most are under `examples/console/dashboards/*` and `examples/tracehooks/*`.

amelia: top issues: 1) `trace_id` -> `tracehex` param rename (examples still use old key) 2) cost breakdown widget uses deprecated `unit` enum 3) a handful of redirects to old docs domain 4) python SDK snippet uses `client.trace()` which is now `client.attach_trace()`

jonathan: can we treat it as two PRs — quick link fixes + param rename/snippet updates? link fixes are low risk and unblock CI.

amelia: yeah that's the plan. quick link sweep first. I'll open the link-fix PR and tag owners.

linda: for the snippet changes we should add a short migration note in the docs page so external users don't get surprised. simple code diff + callout.

samir: for trace param rename, we should include a tiny compatibility shim example showing both keys so customers can see mapping. eg:```json
{
  "tracehex": "abc123",
  "legacy_trace_id": "abc123" // maps from trace_id
}
```

jonathan: good idea. also add a one-liner CLI check to find remaining occurrences before we merge: `rg "trace_id" examples/ | tee /tmp/trace-id-hitlist.txt`

amelia: will add that to PR checklist. I'll also include an automatic replace script snippet:```bash
# replace old param across examples
rg -l "trace_id" examples/ | xargs sed -i "s/trace_id/tracehex/g"
```

linda: ping security: are any example links pointing at customer-specific dashboards? we must not leak anything.

amelia: docs-bot ran a scan — no secrets found, just stale public links and a few internal permalinks that need updating to stable slugs.

docs-bot: automated scan report: 38 files flagged for link updates, 12 examples with `trace_id`, 5 python snippets flagged for API rename. No secrets or creds detected.

samir: plan: I can take the link PR (low risk). amelia you take the snippet + param migration PR. jonathan add the compatibility shim + CLI check to your CI lint step?

jonathan: yep I'll add a lint rule to fail the build if `trace_id` is present in `examples/` after the link PR merges. quick follow-ups: add CHANGELOG entry and a one-liner in the console release notes.

amelia: awesome. I'll create two branches now and post PR links here. target for merge: link fixes by EOD tomorrow, snippets + migration by end of week.

linda: thanks everyone. small Q: do we want to backfill tests that render the dashboard examples (headless) to catch regressions?

samir: yes, open a follow-on ticket. I'll start a draft GH issue and add labels `docs` `observability` `tests`.

amelia: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123 (linkfix) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8124 (snippets). assigning reviewers.

jonathan: left quick review comments on 8123, looks good. :thumbsup:

amelia: merging 8123 once CI is green — then I'll rebase 8124. updating the migration note in the tracehook reference page.

linda: sweet. can someone add a one-sentence note to the console release notes doc so PMs can call it out to customers?

samir: on it. I'll add `docs/release/2026-03-notes.md` bullet: "Observability examples: trace parameter rename and link clean-up — no breaking behavior for pinned configs."

amelia: done — will follow up after 8124 merges with validation that all examples render in our preview. thanks team! :party_popper:
